signals.text: 6 open PM roles across 3 US offices

roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Salesforce Service Cloud and Zoom Contact Center

bullets: Own and manage the end-to-end Order-to-Cash product lifecycle within NetSuite, including roadmap, enhancements, and continuous improvement
Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Order-to-Cash processes, covering order management, billing, invoicing, revenue recognition, and collections
Define, document, and optimize Order-to-Cash business processes to support Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations teams
Partner with Finance and Accounting to ensure accurate, efficient billing and revenue recognition, reducing manual effort and financial close times

roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Salesforce, Sales Cloud and PRM

bullets: Lead Management & Top-of-Funnel Process Own the end-to-end lead lifecycle in Salesforce: capture, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, conversion, and…
Define and govern lead stage and status models, including MQL, SAL, and SQL definitions, entry and exit criteria, and the disposition reasons that make funnel reporting trustworthy
Design and continuously tune lead routing and assignment logic, round robin, territory-based, account-based, and capacity-aware models, along with SLA enforcement and escalation…
Own the marketing-to-sales handoff: alignment with Marketing Operations on campaign attribution, Marketing Automation Platform, MAP-to-CRM sync, form and inbound channel intake…
Improve speed-to-lead and lead-to-opportunity conversion through automation, data quality controls, and AI-assisted qualification where it delivers measurable value
Own, prioritize, and maintain the CPQ product backlog, balancing enhancement requests, defects, technical debt, and roadmap initiatives against business value
Write clear, testable user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria, functional detail, and edge-case handling
Lead sprint ceremonies with the offshore Salesforce development team: backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives
Serve as the day-to-day point of decision for the scrum team, clarifying requirements, unblocking questions, and accepting or rejecting completed stories
Manage release scope and readiness in partnership with the Senior Product Manager, including regression coverage, deployment planning, and post-release validation

roles.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Database Business Unit
roles.location: Austin, Texas; Charlotte, North Carolina; Reston, Virginia

bullets: Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for the database portfolio across self-hosted and SaaS delivery, spanning SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Db2, SAP ASE, and…
Define the portfolio thesis: where we differentiate, where we integrate, where we partner, and where we sunset—and make the trade-offs explicit and defensible to the executive…
Drive the convergence strategy that brings depth-of-domain database capability into the broader SolarWinds Observability platform without diluting what DBAs value most about our…
Own portfolio business outcomes in partnership with BU leadership: ARR growth, net revenue retention, adoption and expansion, pricing and packaging, and margin.
Build and defend the investment case for new bets through sizing, competitive analysis, and buy/build/partner evaluation, and present recommendations to the executive staff.
